eyebrow: Data Modeling & Data Warehousing · Chapter 7, Lesson 33
subtitle: What a columnstore index alone still doesn't solve

code:
CREATE PARTITION FUNCTION
  PF_FactSales_ByYear (INT)
  AS RANGE RIGHT FOR VALUES
  (20220101, 20230101,
   20240101, 20250101);

CREATE PARTITION SCHEME PS_FactSales_ByYear
  AS PARTITION PF_FactSales_ByYear
  ALL TO ([PRIMARY]);
caption: Four boundary values on the date key create five yearly partitions.

code:
-- Move a whole partition in or out --
-- a metadata operation, not a row copy.
ALTER TABLE dbo.Fact_Sales
  SWITCH PARTITION 1
  TO dbo.Fact_Sales_Archive;
caption: A nightly load switches partitions in; a retention job switches them out.
